observations: Photo 0 shows a removed inline-4 car engine with intake manifold, valve cover, serpentine belt, pulleys, and ancillaries.
No brand badge, model name, or engine casting number is legible on the block or covers in the photo.
A watermark across the image reads "NWAKONAUTOLEZE".
The engine is sitting on the ground, not installed in a vehicle.

claims.evidence: No Toyota, Camry, or 5x marking is readable in photo 0.
No guarantee document or warranty terms are visible.
No shipping, customs, or origin documents are visible.
The engine is not running in the photo; no test video is provided.
No audio or running video is available to confirm engine sound.
No odometer is visible on an engine removed from a car.
An external photo cannot confirm whether internal seals or gaskets were previously broken.

risks.risk: Engine does not run or is seized internally.
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting, idling, and revving with sound.

risks.risk: Engine is not a Toyota Camry 5x or is the wrong fitment.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the engine block identification number or VIN plate.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic used engine of unknown make

risks.risk: High internal wear or hidden mechanical damage.
risks.proof: Compression test or leak-down test results, or borescope inspection video.

risks.risk: Engine was previously opened or repaired despite the claim.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of valve cover and timing cover bolts and gasket surfaces.

risks.risk: Origin claim is false; not actually Tokunbo from Belgium.
risks.proof: Customs or shipping documents showing import from Belgium.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running with sound
Clear photo of engine block identification number or VIN plate
Close-up photos of valve cover and timing cover sealing areas
Import or customs documents for the Belgium/Tokunbo claim
response.reason: The photos show a used car engine, so it can be priced at worst case as untested; the claimed Toyota Camry 5x identity and condition cannot be verified from the image alone.
